info.title: SNCF liO — Teacher trip assistant
info.description: Collects and confirms four pieces of school-trip information from French messages.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.description: Limits the client needs to mirror (recording length, upload size). No secrets.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: French sentence: why the request does not fit as asked

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Changes to the confirmed requirements, if any

unlocks.title: Unlocks
unlocks.description: Number of itineraries that become feasible

Adjustment.title: Adjustment
Adjustment.description: One way to make the request feasible. Nothing is applied until the teacher accepts it.

message.title: Message
message.description: French status line for the teacher

departure_station.title: Departure Station
departure_station.description: Departure station OR city, as the teacher said it. A city means any station of that city: the planner expands it.

ConfirmedRequirements.title: ConfirmedRequirements
ConfirmedRequirements.description: Payload handed to the planning module after explicit confirmation.

version.title: Version
version.description: Monotonic version of the requirements; +1 for each applied patch

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.description: Only after /audio: transcript to be corrected

confirmed_requirements.description: Final payload, non-null only in the CONFIRMED state

ConversationResponse.title: ConversationResponse
ConversationResponse.description: Response of all endpoints: the client renders it as is, without recomputing.

ConversationState.title: ConversationState
ConversationState.description: States visible to the client. EXTRACTING/VALIDATING are internal to a request.

theme_match.title: Theme Match
theme_match.description: Why it fits the teacher's subject or theme

label.title: Label
label.description: French label of what was checked

label.title: Label
label.description: What distinguishes this option, e.g. « Journée complète »

free_minutes.title: Free Minutes
free_minutes.description: Time on site not taken by activities or walking

departure_stations.title: Departure Stations
departure_stations.description: Stations the departure may use (a city is expanded)

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: French notes for the teacher (simulation label, assumptions)

message.title: Message
message.description: French line describing the current stage

strict_minutes.title: Strict Minutes
strict_minutes.description: Simulation lever: extra time required on site to exercise the adjustment branch

Journey.title: Journey
Journey.description: Server state of everything after confirmation. The client renders it; it decides nothing.

PartialDateTime.title: PartialDateTime
PartialDateTime.description: Partially known date/time. Complete only if all three fields are filled in.

date.title: Date
date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or null when unknown/unresolved

constraint.description: exact | approximate | earliest | latest, or null

departure_station.title: Departure Station
departure_station.description: Departure station OR city, as the teacher said it. A city means any station of that city.

PartialRequirements.title: PartialRequirements
PartialRequirements.description: Current state of the four requirements, as returned to the client on every turn.

walk_minutes.title: Walk Minutes
walk_minutes.description: Walking time from the arrival station

note.title: Note
note.description: Opening hours, group access, booking conditions — illustrative in simulation

StartJourneyRequest.title: StartJourneyRequest
StartJourneyRequest.description: Scenario switches exist in simulation only, to exercise every branch of the interface.

TeachingType.title: TeachingType
TeachingType.description: Subject and/or teaching theme: either one is enough.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Standard French school subject (Histoire, SVT, ...) or null

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Teaching theme (Moyen Âge, architecture, ...) or null

TimeConstraint.title: TimeConstraint
TimeConstraint.description: exact = « à 8 h »; approximate = « vers 8 h »; earliest = « après 8 h »; latest = « avant 17 h ».

line.title: Line
line.description: Line label. No train number in simulation.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: French lines of the day's timetable

official_links.title: Official Links
official_links.description: Empty in simulation: real links come from the real modules

TravelFile.title: TravelFile
TravelFile.description: The travel file given to the teacher once the booking is confirmed.
